free_policy: Hosted development/free endpoints only for autonomous ClayCode cycles. HTTP 402/payment-required is a hard stop; no paid fallback or automatic upgrade. HTTP 429 is cooldown/fallback.

functions.name: chat
functions.note: Catalog membership and account-executable function availability are distinct; each selected autonomous model must be execution-verified before its evidence is relied on.

functions.name: embedding_similarity
functions.boundary: Similarity is not canonical relation identity, role identity, authority, causal identity or hidden-state equivalence.

functions.name: rerank
functions.note: Historical generic/older route attempts returned 404. Current official model-bound route is queued for runtime re-verification; do not claim PASS until receipt exists.

security_rule: Load NVIDIA_API_KEY only at runtime through rae_secret_loader; never copy credential values into requests, results, logs, packets, claims or reports. Do not persist provider reasoning traces.
routing_rule: Discover catalog first, verify actual execution per selected model, prefer different model families for architect/falsifier/judge, use code embeddings/reranking for evidence selection, and fall back to other free capabilities on 402/429/entitlement failure. Hosted NVIDIA results never substitute for executable Ubuntu ClayCode evidence or target-Qwen/live-FRANK evidence.
